svg.title: Layers are placed in canvas pixels, then the canvas is scaled, and media is cropped by a clipping wrapper
svg.desc: Left: the monitor viewport is 320 by 240 screen pixels, so the 640 by 360 canvas scales by 0.5 and is letterboxed. Layers keep project numbers, such as the image centered at 500, 285. Right: the image is 160 by 90 at scale 1. Cropping a quarter off each side leaves 80 by 90, which placeMedia centers on x 500, so it starts at x 460. A wrapper div with overflow hidden is that visible rectangle, and the image inside stays 160 wide, shifted left by 40, so the cropped sides fall outside the wrapper.

g.text: Place in canvas pixels, scale once, crop by clipping
Numbers are the synthetic sample with the e2e crop (left and right 0.25) on the image.
An outer letterbox div takes the scaled size,
because transform does not change layout.
source 160 × 90 at scale 1, centered on x 500
wrapper div = placeMedia {x 460, w 80}, overflow hidden
stays 160 wide at left −40 inside the wrapper
Hatched: cropped away, clipped by the wrapper.
placeMedia is the same function the compiler uses.
